claude.rationale: gap_45=1: the customer-facing brand asset (name, website, phone numbers, tradename) crossed the ownership boundary while the operational processes producing/delivering rentals did NOT transfer as a going concern — the deal conveyed only "rights... to use the Advantage brand name, website and phone numbers" plus an option on selected leases/concessions, and the brand was run "using the registrant's own car-rental substrate" with "24 corporate Advantage brand rental locations." This is a documented product-vs-process structural mismatch at closing. gap_56=0: no target operational processes (T5) or workforce (T6) transferred at all (T5=null), so no T5-without-T6 mismatch exists; the filings disclose no transition-services or shared-services agreement, so the T4/T5 gap was not contractually absorbed (gap_mitigated=no).

gemini.rationale: The transaction was an asset acquisition of the Advantage brand name, website, phone numbers, and an option to assume certain leases and concession agreements, not a going-concern purchase. The customer-facing brand (T4) and selected assets (T5) crossed, but the operational processes and people (T6) did not cross as an intact going concern, creating structural gaps (gap_45 and gap_56). No transition services agreement was documented to mitigate these gaps.
